title_en: Li Jinhua v. Lirong Pawnshop Co., Ltd. — pawn dispute
ruling_gist_en: After a dead pledge, extinguishing the pawner's right of redemption over the pawned item under the pawn contract does not violate legal provisions and is consistent with pawnbroking industry practices and the general understanding of the public.
